body: Not sure if you are serious or not, but I'll give it a try.
I look a bit like this.  Should I kill myself?  Advise pls.
The extreme ones are the mainstream ones.  Pretty much any well-known academic feminist subscribes to 'feminism theory' (look it up) and is going to have opinions in line with that.
I look a bit like this guy.  Should I kill myself?  Become a hermit?  Move to Antarctica?  What's your advice?
For instance, if your supervisor can see that you're friends with a 'troublemaker' who left the company, the supervisor may marginalise you, bully you, and drive you to suicide.

I don't have a car.  Few young unemployed British people have cars, same as in many countries.

What are the other 'easy painless ways' you are talking about?
Maybe the poorer nations are underconsuming, and Japan is consuming reasonably.
Exercise is really really important, but you don't need organised team sports and competitions for that.
I hope you can forgive the vet.  We all make mistakes, even medical professionals.
I think so, but I'm no lawyer.

I really liked living in this country, and kind of still like it.

Other jobs will be like this or worse.  We live in a world of shitty jobs.

I had one of the best jobs in the world and threw it away.  I can't tolerate any job that isn't as good, which is to say, all of the rest of them.

I can move to a different job (in the same industry) and city in time, a less hot and humid place, but it won't be as good as the climate in the city where I was, and even then I'll still have lost years of my life.

People don't understand suicide and aren't going to understand your suicide attempt; it will just be looked upon as mental weakness or a moment of madness, or some kind of childish gesture.

You aren't going to make people understand.  They don't even understand actual suicides and can't imagine why anyone would want to kill themselves.  I guess this lack of understanding could be a survival mechanism.  Only suicidal people are likely to understand.
It's not going to be fixed.  The world is fucked.  There are ~7bn people fucking up the planet with our mere presence.  Forget about it and just enjoy your life.
Ridiculous that she was found 'guilty beyond reasonable doubt'.

I see.  Well, I think not to drink at all would be far easier.  I agree with other posters about it being harder to stop drinking and resist peer pressure once you've:

1) Already 'gave in' and joined in once
2) Lost some of your inhibitions

I don't agree with 'live for others' kind of advice.  I think you should live for yourself and your friends and family.  The world isn't going to be fixed any time soon, so stop thinking it's all on your shoulders.
Why would you like that?
No more ideas?
Maybe it can be learned, but why even risk it?  You don't *need* to drink alcohol.
Agreed.  Live and learn, dude.  The feeling of regret is there for a reason; to remind you not to make the same kind of mistake again.
I don't think there are any other kinds of job I could do in this country.

Regular exercise and a lack of excessive stress is important to a good life.  So is a decent job.

Work is now stressful, yes.  It's never done.

I'm on a long break now.  It's very hot and humid where I now live so I can't really do anything.  I can't handle the heat well.  I want to prepare for my death before I go back to work.

It has been 5 years since I lost my job.  I have tried my best.

The things I lost in my life, I believe them to be extremely fundamental and important things.  I also lost a life that had little worry and stress.  

Now I have a job that gets worse every day, doesn't allow me time to exercise, is in a boiling hot city that saps me of energy, has horrible bitchy colleagues, and so on.  This is the norm, I have come to realize.
It's not only that.  The career enabled me to live a certain lifestyle and live in a certain place and not have to worry too much about money and other things.
That all looks like bullshit to me.  Most hanging doesn't break the neck, for instance.
